parameter.label: EMPRESA : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT EMP.CODEMP AS VALUE, EMP.CODEMP || '- '||EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP EMP ORDER BY 1

chart.title: Despesas
chart.expression:
SELECT SUM(DESPESA) AS DESPESA, DESCRNAT FROM( SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = -1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, NAT.DESCRNAT
FROM TGFFIN FIN INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON ROUND((fin.CODNAT / 10000),0) * 10000 = NAT.CODNAT INNER JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CUS.CODCENCUS = FIN.CODCENCUS LEFT JOIN TGFMBC MBC ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO LEFT JOIN TSICTA CTA ON CTA.CODCTABCOINT = MBC.CODCTABCOINT WHERE FIN.DHBAIXA >= :PERIODO.INI AND FIN.DHBAIXA <= :PERIODO.FIN AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND FIN.PROVISAO='N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((CTA.CLASSE IS NULL OR CTA.CLASSE <> 'D')) AND (FIN.CODEMP in :EMPRESA) GROUP BY NAT.DESCRNAT
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN MBC.VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, NAT.DESCRNAT FROM TGFMBC MBC INNER JOIN TSICTA CTA ON MBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON MBC.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON ROUND((fin.CODNAT / 10000),0) * 10000 = NAT.CODNAT WHERE MBC.DTLANC >= :PERIODO.INI AND MBC.DTLANC < :PERIODO.FIN AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND FIN.PROVISAO='N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND CTA.CLASSE = 'D' AND (FIN.CODEMP IN :EMPRESA) AND :ADIANTAMENTO = 'S' GROUP BY NAT.DESCRNAT) GROUP BY DESCRNAT ORDER BY 1 DESC

chart.expression:
SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN FIN.RECDESP = 1 THEN FIN.VLRDESDOB ELSE 0 END) AS RECEITA, NAT.DESCRNAT, NAT.CODNAT
FROM TGFFIN FIN INNER JOIN TGFNAT NATp ON ROUND((fin.CODNAT / 10000),0) * 10000 = NATP.CODNAT INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON ROUND((fin.CODNAT / 100),0) * 100 = NAT.CODNAT INNER JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CUS.CODCENCUS = FIN.CODCENCUS WHERE FIN.DHBAIXA >= :PERIODO.INI AND FIN.DHBAIXA <= :PERIODO.FIN AND NATP.DESCRNAT= :DESCRNAT AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND FIN.PROVISAO='N' AND (FIN.CODCENCUS = :CODCENCUS OR :CODCENCUS IS NULL) AND FIN.RECDESP = 1
AND FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND ((FIN.CODEMP = :EMPRESA) OR (:EMPRESA IS NULL)) GROUP BY NAT.DESCRNAT,NAT.CODNAT order by 1 desc
